description: This file defines a Java interface 'FilePut' that declares methods for adding single and multiple files associated with a merchant store, specifically related to content management.

classes.name: FilePut
classes.description: A Java interface for content file upload operations related to merchant stores.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single content file to the merchant store identified by 'merchantStoreCode'.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files to the merchant store identified by 'merchantStoreCode'.
